topic: `orch run` needs an unlocked terminal once a policy is applied
detail: `orch run <space> -- claude|codex` reads the applied policy through DiffSpaces (internal/cli/run_cmd.go appliedPolicy), which is operator-only (refuseNonOperator). Under a policy only Orch.app is the operator (D-71), so from a plain terminal `orch run` is refused, and it works only as `orch spaces unlock --for 15m -- orch run <space> -- claude` confirmed in Orch.app. Codex sessions depend on `orch run` for per-space settings (it has no per-checkout file), so this adds a confirmation per launch. Options: (a) keep it and document it (done in docs/SPACES.md and docs/internals/install.md); (b) add a read-only RPC that returns only the named space's launch profile (its own roots, denies, gh and Claude config dirs) to a terminal caller, without the other spaces' orgs and roots; (c) let Orch.app launch `orch run` sessions. Recommendation: (b), since the launcher needs only the one space's profile.
